The mood conveyed in the text is one of warmth, nostalgia, and gentle melancholy. The description of the park as a "festival of colors" and the imagery of leaves swirling in the wind create a visually rich and vibrant atmosphere. However, this vibrancy is tempered by the "wistful atmosphere of change," suggesting a bittersweet recognition of the season's transition. The mention of couples and children adds a layer of coziness and communal joy, while the "promise of the coming winter" introduces a sense of quiet anticipation and rest. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by establishing a serene, reflective tone that contrasts with the busyness of other seasons, inviting the reader to pause and appreciate the beauty of impermanence.
